clue.text: Procession beginning to go round the square

parts.note: a procession is a parade

indicators.note: the beginning of the word go is its opening letter

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A march sets off and circles the town square.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beginning to go' gives G, the first letter of 'go'.
explanation.definitionFit: A parade ground is the open drill square of a barracks, so it is a military square.

clue.text: She took the lid off every evil cause

definitions.text: She took the lid off every evil cause

parts.words: She took the lid off every evil cause
parts.note: read as the Greek myth of the first woman who opened a jar or box and let every evil out into the world

explanation.surface: A woman lifts the lid and unleashes every wicked thing.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth this woman opened the forbidden box and released all the world's evils, the root cause of them.

clue.text: Notice read out in light entertainment

indicators.note: something read out is spoken, so the word is replaced by one that sounds the same

parts.note: a notice is a critic's write-up of a show, a review

explanation.surface: A critic's notice is read aloud at a light show.
explanation.definitionFit: A revue is a light theatrical show of sketches and songs, a form of light entertainment.

clue.text: Symptoms of mental disorder appearing, unless I do shifts

indicators.note: the letters of the preceding words shift into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Signs of madness show up unless a patient works shifts.
explanation.definitionFit: False beliefs held against all evidence are classic signs of psychiatric illness.

clue.text: Short saying about where time casts its shadow

indicators.note: short means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: a gnome is a pithy saying or maxim
on means about, concerning

explanation.surface: A brief proverb about time and shadows.
explanation.walkthrough: GNOME in the sense of an aphorism is uncommon; 'Short' trims it to GNOM.
explanation.definitionFit: The gnomon is the upright pin of a sundial whose shadow marks the hour.

clue.text: Mood of the wishful thinker in Greece

definitions.text: Mood of the wishful thinker in Greece

parts.words: Mood of the wishful thinker in Greece
parts.note: mood is the grammatical term, and ancient Greek has a verb form for expressing wishes

explanation.surface: A dreamer in Greece is in a hopeful frame of mind.
explanation.definitionFit: Ancient Greek grammar has a verb mood used to express wishes, distinct from indicative and subjunctive.

clue.text: Row in northern French river

parts.note: the Oise is a river in northern France

explanation.surface: A quarrel breaks out on a river in the north of France.
explanation.definitionFit: A row, rhyming with cow, is a loud din or racket.

clue.text: Lady's family in G&S — they're usually in a pickle

indicators.note: the lady's family is placed inside the two letters

parts.note: G and S, the letters themselves, as in Gilbert and Sullivan
a lady's belongings are hers
family means kin

explanation.surface: A noble lady's relatives in a Gilbert and Sullivan opera are always in trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: G&S evokes Gilbert and Sullivan operas, but only its letters G and S are used.
explanation.definitionFit: Small pickled cucumbers are almost always found in jars of vinegar pickle.

clue.text: Vestment on knight is hot

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits on top of the second

parts.note: a stole is a priest's vestment, a long scarf
N is the chess abbreviation for knight

explanation.surface: A knight wears a church vestment that is a sought-after item.
explanation.definitionFit: Hot is slang for stolen goods, so 'is hot' means the item was nicked.

clue.text: Previously unknown story

definitions.meaning: new and original, never seen before
a long work of prose fiction

explanation.definitionFit: Novel means new and original as an adjective, and as a noun a book-length fictional story.

clue.text: Say what you think, and be too clever for popular success

parts.note: to outwit someone is to be too clever for them
a hit is a popular success

explanation.surface: Speak your mind, and be too sharp to win the crowd over.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom urges someone to speak plainly and say what is on their mind.

clue.text: Taxi too much, perhaps, and use horn excessively, without point

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the point goes inside

parts.note: over as a prefix means excessively
to hoot is to sound a car horn
S is south, a compass point

explanation.surface: A cab driver honks too much and goes past the stop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' here means outside: S sits inside OVERHOOT. A plane that taxies past the end of the runway overshoots.
explanation.definitionFit: An aircraft that runs past the end of its runway while taxiing is said to overshoot it.

clue.text: Loner ordered to join up

indicators.note: the letters of the word are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A solitary type is told to sign up.
explanation.definitionFit: To enlist or sign up as a member is to join up.

clue.text: Plying to and fro, Charon would scarcely need it

definitions.text: Plying to and fro, Charon would scarcely need it

indicators.note: the ferryman's back-and-forth plying jumbles his name's letters

explanation.surface: The ferryman of the dead, always crossing the Styx, hardly needs to moor.
explanation.walkthrough: Charon is the mythical ferryman of the river Styx; a boat always moving has little use for mooring.
explanation.definitionFit: A ferry forever shuttling across never stops, so it would hardly need the weight that holds a boat in place.

clue.text: Found Blue disheartened

parts.note: to found metal is to cast it
blue means sad, down

explanation.surface: Someone who found the blues is downcast.
explanation.definitionFit: Cast down is a phrase meaning dejected or low in spirits.

clue.text: Dislike article's particular account

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
a version is one person's particular account of events

explanation.surface: Someone dislikes a certain telling of events.
explanation.definitionFit: An aversion is a strong dislike or distaste.

clue.text: Brighten up in brief rush to get drunk

indicators.note: drunk suggests the letters are reeling into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Cheering up with a quick dash to the pub.
explanation.definitionFit: To renovate and redecorate a place is to freshen or brighten it up.

clue.text: Combined to cheat nightclub

parts.note: to con someone is to cheat them
a joint is slang for a club or bar

explanation.surface: A scam is run at a seedy nightclub.
explanation.definitionFit: Conjoint means joined together, united, combined.

clue.text: It obstructs current religious education given by nun, say

parts.note: RE is the school subject Religious Education

indicators.note: say signals that the word is spoken, a sound-alike

parts.note: a nun is a sister

explanation.surface: A nun teaches religion at school.
explanation.walkthrough: 'current' is electric current, not a modern trend.
explanation.definitionFit: A resistor is an electronic component that opposes the flow of electric current.

clue.text: It helps one to see Greek wine contains no sulphur

indicators.note: the wine has the letter for sulphur taken out

parts.note: retsina is a resin-flavoured Greek wine
S is the chemical symbol for sulphur

explanation.surface: Greek wine free of sulphites helps your eyesight.
explanation.definitionFit: The light-sensitive layer at the back of the eye makes sight possible.

clue.text: Compensation for cancelled games

parts.note: an event that is off has been cancelled
in tennis a set is made up of games

explanation.surface: Being paid back for matches that were called off.
explanation.definitionFit: An offset is something that counterbalances or compensates for another thing.

clue.text: One may look a bit glazed when toasted

definitions.text: One may look a bit glazed when toasted

parts.words: One may look a bit glazed when toasted
parts.note: toasted suggests a drunk person with glazed eyes, but it is a sweet bun with a shiny top, toasted for tea

explanation.definitionFit: A currant bun often has a glazed top and is usually eaten split and toasted.

clue.text: Harm done by female, caging lion, perhaps?

indicators.note: the female surrounds the animal as a cage would

parts.note: she is a female
a lion is an example of a big cat

explanation.surface: A woman has caught a lion and done damage.
explanation.definitionFit: To scathe is an old verb meaning to harm or injure.

clue.text: Owen's house style

definitions.meaning: Owen ... was the Welsh founder of the royal house that ruled England from 1485
the architectural style of that period, with black timbers and white plaster

explanation.definitionFit: Tudor is both the dynasty founded by Owen Tudor's family and the half-timbered building style of its era.

clue.text: Rebuff uppity pariah

indicators.note: uppity means going up, so in a down clue the word is read bottom to top

parts.note: a leper is a social outcast, a pariah

explanation.surface: An outcast getting above themselves is snubbed.
explanation.definitionFit: To repel someone is to drive them back or rebuff them.

clue.text: A raja can fuss about daughter in a tree

indicators.note: the jumbled letters go round the next piece
a fuss throws the letters into disorder

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: An Indian prince makes a fuss over his daughter up a tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fuss' scrambles the three opening words into JACARANA, and 'about' wraps that round D; 'in a' before 'tree' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: The jacaranda is a tropical tree known for its purple-blue blossom.

clue.text: In depression, a dire state

indicators.note: in signals that the answer sits inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: Someone depressed is in a terrible way.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: the lowest point of a depression is a dire state.
explanation.definitionFit: The nadir is the lowest point, the depth of despair in a depression.

clue.text: Fresh tear in paper

parts.note: fresh means new
to tear along is to sprint

explanation.surface: A new rip appears in a sheet of paper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tear' wants to be a rip, rhyming with fair; it is a dash, rhyming with fear.
explanation.definitionFit: Newsprint is the cheap paper newspapers are printed on.

clue.text: The country to help Northern Ireland's come-back

indicators.note: a comeback means the whole sequence runs back to front

parts.note: to aid is to help
NI is the abbreviation for Northern Ireland

explanation.surface: The nation lends a hand to Northern Ireland's recovery.
explanation.definitionFit: India is a country in South Asia.

clue.text: Garments exhibited by Copenhagen dandy, perhaps

parts.note: garments are clothes
Copenhagen was the Duke of Wellington's horse at Waterloo

explanation.surface: Clothes on display from a Danish fashion plate.
explanation.walkthrough: Copenhagen looks like the Danish capital, but it was Wellington's famous charger.
explanation.definitionFit: A man obsessed with fine clothes is called a clothes horse, so a dandy is an example.
